note: Hand-written lookup from the desktop marketing names people type to the GPU die or dies those boards use. It lists only names whose die is public NVIDIA product knowledge; a name that is missing is not in the table, and the page then asks for the die itself (for example GA106). site/test_status.py checks it against the repository's own die rules and the boards named in coverage.json. It is not generated and not verified against hardware.
variants: Board variants of one name can use a different die than the one listed. If your card is not found under the die shown, enter the die id instead (GPU-Z names it).
laptops: Laptop and mobile GPUs share names with desktop cards but use other dies. They are not covered and nothing here is a result for them.
unmapped: Not in the table: GeForce GTX 10 series and older, workstation cards (RTX A series, RTX Ada and Quadro boards), data-centre GPUs, and every name this table does not list. Enter the die (for example GA106) to look one up.
